# Setup SNPs

Script to get SNPs ready for GWAS analysis and create pop structure info.

We want to filter SNPs to retain those that are biallelic, have a minor allele frequency >= 0.05, and are genotyped in at least 70% of individuals. We also want to remove SNPs with a correlation > 0.9.

We will use [PLINK 1.9](https://www.cog-genomics.org/plink/1.9/) for these steps. Because this is a plant genome with non-standard chromosome names, `bcftools` first enumerates and extracts the contigs, and PLINK is run with `--allow-extra-chr`. The chromosome jobs run in parallel. LD pruning uses an r² threshold of 0.81, corresponding to an absolute correlation of 0.9, within sliding windows of 1,000 variants.

The per-chromosome results are written under `filtered_snps` in the same directory as the input BCF. Set `N_JOBS` to control the number of concurrent chromosome jobs.

After creating a filtered SNP list, we use that to creat a kinship matrix and PCAs to use for population structure correction.

Ideally we would use (BEAGLE)[https://faculty.washington.edu/browning/beagle/beagle.html] or something to impute missing SNP genotypes.  That has not been done here.

Note all code in this script is **bash** not R.

```{bash}
# set -euo pipefail

BCF=/analyzed_data/GWAS_workshop/data/WL2_2025_Stor_combined.bcf
OUTDIR="$(dirname "$BCF")/filtered_snps"
N_JOBS=7
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"
export BCF OUTDIR

# Process each contig separately for speed
bcftools query -f '%CHROM\n' "$BCF" | sort -u | \
    xargs -r -P "$N_JOBS" -I '{}' bash -c '
        # set -euo pipefail
        chr="$1"
        chr_bcf="$OUTDIR/.${chr}.input.bcf"

        bcftools view -Ob -o "$chr_bcf" -t "$chr" "$BCF"

        # Retain biallelic SNPs with MAF >= 0.05 and call rate >= 70%.
        plink1.9 --allow-extra-chr --bcf "$chr_bcf" --double-id \
            --set-missing-var-ids '@:#:$r:$a' \
            --biallelic-only strict --snps-only just-acgt --maf 0.05 --geno 0.30 \
            --make-bed --out "$OUTDIR/WL2_2025_${chr}.maf_filtered"

        # Identify correlated variants, then retain the pruned set.
        plink1.9 --allow-extra-chr --bfile "$OUTDIR/WL2_2025_${chr}.maf_filtered" \
            --indep-pairwise 1000 50 0.81 --out "$OUTDIR/WL2_2025_${chr}.ld"
        plink1.9 --allow-extra-chr --bfile "$OUTDIR/WL2_2025_${chr}.maf_filtered" \
            --extract "$OUTDIR/WL2_2025_${chr}.ld.prune.in" --make-bed \
            --out "$OUTDIR/WL2_2025_${chr}.final"

        rm "$chr_bcf"
    ' _ '{}'
```

Combine the chromosome filesets into one PLINK fileset. The output will be
`WL2_2025_merge_filtered.bed`, `WL2_2025_merge_filtered.bim`, and `WL2_2025_merge_filtered.fam`.

```{bash}
#set -euo pipefail

BCF=/analyzed_data/GWAS_workshop/data/WL2_2025_Stor_combined.bcf
OUTDIR="$(dirname "$BCF")/filtered_snps"
MERGED_OUT="$OUTDIR/WL2_2025_merge_filtered"

shopt -s nullglob
final_beds=("$OUTDIR"/*.final.bed)
shopt -u nullglob
if (( ${#final_beds[@]} == 0 )); then
    echo "No per-chromosome .final.bed files found in $OUTDIR" >&2
    exit 1
fi

base_prefix="${final_beds[0]%.bed}"
if (( ${#final_beds[@]} == 1 )); then
    plink1.9 --allow-extra-chr --bfile "$base_prefix" \
        --make-bed --out "$MERGED_OUT"
else
    merge_list="$(mktemp "$OUTDIR/.merge-list.XXXXXX")"
    trap 'rm -f "$merge_list"' EXIT
    for bed in "${final_beds[@]:1}"; do
        printf '%s\n' "${bed%.bed}" >> "$merge_list"
    done

    plink1.9 --allow-extra-chr --bfile "$base_prefix" \
        --merge-list "$merge_list" --make-bed --out "$MERGED_OUT"
fi

# remove single chrome files
 rm *Chr*
```
Total after filtering: 574352

Take a look at Missingness:

```{bash}
BCF=/analyzed_data/GWAS_workshop/data/WL2_2025_Stor_combined.bcf
OUTDIR="$(dirname "$BCF")/filtered_snps"
MERGED_OUT="$OUTDIR/WL2_2025_merge_filtered"

plink1.9 --allow-extra-chr --bfile "$MERGED_OUT" \
    --missing --out "$OUTDIR/WL2_2025_merge_filtered_missing"

awk '
NR == 1 {
    for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) {
        if ($i == "F_MISS") miss_col = i
    }
    next
}
{
    call_rate = 1 - $miss_col
    if (call_rate >= 0.50) n50++
    if (call_rate >= 0.60) n60++
    if (call_rate >= 0.70) n70++
    if (call_rate >= 0.80) n80++
    if (call_rate >= 0.90) n90++
}
END {
    printf "At least 50%% called: %d SNPs\n", n50
    printf "At least 60%% called: %d SNPs\n", n60
    printf "At least 70%% called: %d SNPs\n", n70
    printf "At least 80%% called: %d SNPs\n", n80
    printf "At least 90%% called: %d SNPs\n", n90
}' "$OUTDIR/WL2_2025_merge_filtered_missing.lmiss"
```

Calculate a square genetic relationship (kinship) matrix and principal components
from the merged, LD-pruned SNP set. PLINK writes `WL2_2025_merge_filtered.rel` and
`WL2_2025_merge_filtered.id` for the relationship matrix, plus eigenvalue and
eigenvector files for the first 10 principal components.

```{bash}
set -euo pipefail

BCF=/analyzed_data/GWAS_workshop/data/WL2_2025_Stor_combined.bcf
OUTDIR="$(dirname "$BCF")/filtered_snps"
MERGED_OUT="$OUTDIR/WL2_2025_merge_filtered"
THREADS=6

plink1.9 --allow-extra-chr --bfile "$MERGED_OUT" \
    --threads "$THREADS" --make-rel square \
    --out "$OUTDIR/WL2_2025_merge_filtered_kinship"

plink1.9 --allow-extra-chr --bfile "$MERGED_OUT" \
    --threads "$THREADS" --pca 10 \
    --out "$OUTDIR/WL2_2025_merge_filtered_pca"
```
